title: Building Software Systems At Google and Lessons Learned
summary: Jeff Dean of Google describes his experiences building Google's systems and how its infrastructure evolved over time. The Stanford talk covers search, scaling tipping points and lessons from building large-scale software.
why: HN recommends it as a classic look at systems engineering at Google, whose fundamentals have held up well despite its 2010 date.

quote.text: It's from 2010, but the fundamentals probably haven't changed.
